errors.what: “TRH (pulsatile)” labels the hypothalamus → anterior pituitary arrow.
errors.why_wrong: The ovarian axis uses pulsatile GnRH. TRH belongs to the thyroid axis. [Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/books/NBK279070/)

errors.what: “TSH” labels an anterior pituitary → ovary arrow.
errors.why_wrong: The ovarian gonadotropins are LH and FSH. TSH primarily targets the thyroid. [Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK499898/)

errors.what: “ACTH” labels the other anterior pituitary → ovary arrow.
errors.why_wrong: ACTH primarily targets the adrenal cortex; this arrow should represent LH or FSH. [Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK499898/)

errors.what: “Solid (−): estradiol and progesterone suppress GnRH, LH and FSH for most of the cycle.”
errors.why_wrong: This treats progesterone as a major suppressive signal throughout the cycle, although it is low during much of the follicular phase and rises after ovulation. [Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279054/)

errors.what: “Dotted (−): inhibin B from granulosa cells suppresses FSH only.”
errors.why_wrong: Inhibin B is chiefly the follicular phase form; inhibin A dominates in the luteal phase. The unqualified label can suggest that inhibin B supplies this feedback throughout the cycle. [Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279054/figure/female_the-normal-menstrual-cycle-and-the-control-of-ovulation.F2/?report=objectonly)

errors.what: The solid and dashed feedback paths end in ordinary arrowheads, while their hormone identities and effects appear only in the small legend.
errors.why_wrong: The paths show where feedback goes but make inhibition versus stimulation difficult to distinguish from the drawing alone.

errors.what: The node labels, arrow labels, and legend are very small in the rendered image.
errors.why_wrong: Several labels require zooming to read comfortably.

errors.what: The figure occupies only the upper portion of a much taller image.
errors.why_wrong: The large blank area makes the teaching diagram smaller than necessary at this display size.

verdict: The feedback layout is recognizable, but three central hormone labels teach the wrong axis. Correcting them and enlarging the diagram are essential before use.
